result.executive_summary: This Land Lease Agreement outlines the terms between Mr. Rajesh Kumar Sharma and Ms. Priya Natarajan for a five-year lease of agricultural land in Pune, India. Key points include annual rent, security deposit, use restrictions, maintenance responsibilities, dispute resolution, and jurisdiction.
key_points: Lease term for five years, starting June 1, 2025.
Annual rent of INR 1,50,000 (one lakh fifty thousand) payable annually on June 5th.
Lessee must pay a refundable security deposit of INR 50,000 at lease execution.
Land to be used strictly for organic farming; no unauthorized use allowed.
Lessor responsible for all government taxes and duties related to the land.
No sub-leasing or assignment without Lessor's written consent.
Either party can terminate with 3 months' notice, or non-breaching party may terminate immediately upon breach.
obligations: Pay annual rent on June 5th each year.
Pay refundable security deposit of INR 50,000 at lease execution.
Use land strictly for organic farming and not for unlawful purposes.
Maintain land in good condition; no permanent structural changes without Lessor's consent.
Lessor responsible for all government taxes and duties related to the land.
No sub-leasing or assignment of premises without prior written consent from Lessor.
risks: Risk of non-payment of rent by Lessee, leading to potential termination of lease.
Risk of unauthorized use of leased land by Lessee, potentially resulting in breach and termination.
Risk of disputes over maintenance or structural changes requiring prior written consent from Lessor.

key_points: Lease term for 5 years from June 1, 2025 to May 31, 2030.
Annual rent of INR 1,50,000 payable on or before June 5 each year.
Refundable security deposit of INR 50,000 at the time of agreement execution.
Lessee must use land for organic farming and not for unlawful purposes.
Lessor is responsible for government taxes related to the land.
Lessee cannot sublease or assign the premises without Lessor's consent.
Either party can terminate the lease with a 3-month written notice, or upon breach of terms.
Disputes will be resolved through amicable negotiations or arbitration in Pune, India.
obligations: Lessor must maintain land in good condition and not make permanent structural changes without consent.
Lessee must pay rent annually on June 5th.
Lessee must use the land for organic farming as agreed.
Lessor is responsible for government taxes related to the land.
risks: Termination of lease by either party with a 3-month notice period.
Disputes may arise and be resolved through arbitration, which could lead to legal costs.

result.executive_summary: This Land Lease Agreement outlines the terms and conditions for a 5-year lease of a 1.5-acre agricultural land in Pune, Maharashtra, India.
key_points: The lease term is for 5 years, commencing from 1st June 2025 and ending on 31st May 2030.
The Lessee agrees to pay an annual rent of INR 1,50,000 and a refundable security deposit of INR 50,000.
obligations: The Lessor is responsible for maintaining the land in good condition and paying all government taxes and duties.
The Lessee agrees to use the leased land strictly for organic farming activities and obtain prior written consent for any changes.
risks: If the Lessee fails to pay rent or damages the land, the Lessor may terminate the lease and retain the security deposit.
